quests.instruction: AUDIT SYNTAX AND CORRECT THE FAULTY GRAMMATICAL PHRASE
quests.passage: [Calibration Audit 191-1] Each of the deep submersibles [are ready] for the Mariana Trench survey.
quests.hint: Focus on subject-verb agreement for the singular pronoun 'Each'. (Diving calibration index 191-1)
quests.explanation: Singular indefinite pronouns like 'Each' demand a singular verb 'is', not a plural verb 'are'. [Verified by Academy Syntax Unit 191].

quests.instruction: AUDIT SYNTAX AND CORRECT THE FAULTY GRAMMATICAL PHRASE
quests.passage: [Calibration Audit 191-2] Neither of the geothermal vents [have stopped] emitting chemical gases.
quests.hint: Determine the correct singular verb form matching the pronoun 'Neither'. (Diving calibration index 191-2)
quests.explanation: Indefinite pronouns like 'Neither' are singular and require the singular auxiliary verb 'has'. [Verified by Academy Syntax Unit 191].

quests.instruction: AUDIT SYNTAX AND CORRECT THE FAULTY GRAMMATICAL PHRASE
quests.passage: [Calibration Audit 191-3] Winds trigger cold upwellings, which [carries] deep ocean nutrients upward.
quests.hint: Ensure the relative pronoun 'which' matches its plural antecedent 'upwellings'. (Diving calibration index 191-3)
quests.explanation: The relative pronoun 'which' refers to the plural antecedent 'upwellings', demanding the plural verb 'carry'. [Verified by Academy Syntax Unit 191].

quests.instruction: AUDIT SYNTAX AND CORRECT THE FAULTY GRAMMATICAL PHRASE
quests.passage: [Calibration Audit 192-1] Deep-sea bioluminescent fish [uses] cold chemical luciferin to light up lures.

quests.explanation: In this plural context, 'fish' functions as a plural subject, requiring the plural base verb 'use'. [Verified by Academy Syntax Unit 192].

quests.instruction: AUDIT SYNTAX AND CORRECT THE FAULTY GRAMMATICAL PHRASE
quests.passage: [Calibration Audit 192-2] The towering canopy of giant kelp sanctuaries [shelter] diverse marine creatures.
